messages.author: Oscar Lindqvist
messages.text: For the weekly UA report, which week do I use on a Monday morning: the week that just ended or the one before?

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: The week that just ended (Mon-Sun), compared with the week before it. D7 ROAS in that report always uses the latest D7-mature cohorts, which lag by a week. State both windows at the top. Template is on Confluence.
